label: Email Compose
description: A modern email compose window sized for video: From, To as recipient chips, a bold subject and the body typing in, a formatting bar and the brand's Send button. On send (send_at, send:true, or a scripted click on send-button) the button presses, the window lifts away and a 'Sent' toast lands. ai adds a 'Drafted with Quotient' chip over the body. Themed from the brand background.

to.label: To: one or more addresses or list names, comma separated (shown as chips)

ai.label: Show an AI-drafted chip over the body: true, or its text (default 'Drafted with Quotient')

send.label: Send when the body has finished typing

attachments.label: Attachment names shown under the body

script_actions.description: Type text into the email body or fields
Click To, Subject, or Send button
